legend: Professor Ibrahim has prepared the final homework for his algorithm’s class. He asked his students to implement the Posterization Image Filter.

Their algorithm will be tested on an array of integers, where the i$$$i$$$-th integer represents the color of the i$$$i$$$-th pixel in the image. The image is in black and white, therefore the color of each pixel will be an integer between 0 and 255 (inclusive).

To implement the filter, students are required to divide the black and white color range [0, 255] into groups of consecutive colors, and select one color in each group to be the group’s key. In order to preserve image details, the size of a group must not be greater than k$$$k$$$, and each color should belong to exactly one group.
Finally, the students will replace the color of each pixel in the array with that color’s assigned group key.
To better understand the effect, here is an image of a basking turtle where the Posterization Filter was applied with increasing k$$$k$$$ to the right.

To make the process of checking the final answer easier, Professor Ibrahim wants students to divide the groups and assign the keys in a way that produces the lexicographically smallest possible array.
input: The first line of input contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n≤105$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$, 1≤k≤256$$$1 \leq k \leq 256$$$), the number of pixels in the image, and the maximum size of a group, respectively.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$ (0≤pi≤255$$$0 \leq p_i \leq 255$$$), where pi$$$p_i$$$ is the color of the i$$$i$$$-th pixel.
output: Print n$$$n$$$ space-separated integers; the lexicographically smallest possible array that represents the image after applying the Posterization filter.
note: One possible way to group colors and assign keys for the first sample:
Color 2$$$2$$$ belongs to the group [0,2]$$$[0,2]$$$, with group key 0$$$0$$$.
Color 14$$$14$$$ belongs to the group [12,14]$$$[12,14]$$$, with group key 12$$$12$$$.
Colors 3$$$3$$$ and 4$$$4$$$ belong to group [3,5]$$$[3, 5]$$$, with group key 3$$$3$$$.
Other groups won't affect the result so they are not listed here.

legend.ai: Ibrahim 教授为他的算法课程准备了最后一次作业。他要求学生实现海报化图像滤镜。
他们的算法将在一个整数数组上进行测试，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数表示图像中第 i$$$i$$$ 个像素的颜色。该图像为黑白图像，因此每个像素的颜色都是介于 0 和 255(包括 0 和 255)之间的整数。
为了实现该滤镜，学生需要将黑白颜色范围 [0, 255] 划分为若干组连续的颜色，并在每组中选择一种颜色作为该组的键值。为了保留图像细节，每组的大小不得超过 k$$$k$$$，且每种颜色必须恰好属于一组。
最后，学生会将数组中每个像素的颜色替换为该颜色所属分组的键值。
为了更好地理解其效果，下面给出一张晒太阳的海龟图片，其中从左到右应用的色调分离滤镜的 k$$$k$$$ 逐渐增大。
为了使检查最终答案的过程更加容易，Ibrahim 教授希望学生以一种能够生成字典序最小数组的方式划分各组并分配键值。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n≤105$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$，1≤k≤256$$$1 \leq k \leq 256$$$)，分别表示图像中的像素数量和每组的最大大小。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$(0≤pi≤255$$$0 \leq p_i \leq 255$$$)，其中 pi$$$p_i$$$ 是第 i$$$i$$$ 个像素的颜色。

output.ai: 输出 n$$$n$$$ 个用空格分隔的整数，即应用色调分离滤镜后表示该图像的所有可能数组中字典序最小的数组。
